hooks.name: prevent-console-log
hooks.description: Warn about console.log in production code

hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
if grep -q 'console\.log' "$file_path"; then
  echo '[Hook] Warning: console.log found. Remove before production.' >&2
fi

hooks.name: check-docker-before-execution
hooks.description: Verify Docker is running before execution

hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
if ! docker ps &>/dev/null; then
  echo '[Hook] Error: Docker is not running!' >&2
  exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash
if [[ $file_path == *.java ]]; then
  # Format Java with google-java-format
  java -jar google-java-format.jar --replace "$file_path"
elif [[ $file_path == *.ts* ]]; then
  # Format TypeScript with prettier
  npx prettier --write "$file_path"
fi

#!/bin/bash
if [[ $file_path == "pom.xml" ]]; then
  ./mvnw dependency:analyze
elif [[ $file_path == "package.json" ]]; then
  npm audit
fi

#!/bin/bash
echo '[Hook] Running affected tests...' >&2
if [[ $file_path == *.java ]]; then
  ./mvnw test -Dtest=$(basename ${file_path%.java})Test
fi
